# Synthetic Note Pro fixtures

These files contain test-only keys and generated data, never user credentials or
recorded audio. The RSA pair is intentionally public test material.

`pro-test-recording.asr` was generated with Python cryptography: a512-byte
version1header, independent binascii.crc_hqx(init0xffff), PKCS#1v1.5 wrapped
32-byte key at256, nonce at132, and IETFChaCha20 counter0 plaintext
`OggSsynthetic plaintext for encryption fixture` after512.
